rca_of_issue: Bug: Entire web preview was blank (all routes returned a white page; bundle endpoint returned HTTP 500). Root cause: /app/frontend/app/auth/login.tsx had a 3-line orphan fragment after the legitimate StyleSheet.create({...}) close on line 682 — lines 683-685 contained ': COLORS.textMuted,\n  },\n});' — a leftover from a prior edit (probably an in-place change to the otpCancelText style that wasn't fully cleaned up). Babel raised 'SyntaxError: /app/frontend/app/auth/login.tsx: Unexpected token (683:0)' and Metro failed every bundle request with 500. Reproduction: `curl https://dashboard-rewire.preview.emergentagent.com/node_modules/expo-router/entry.bundle?platform=web` → HTTP/1.1 500. Fix: removed the 3 dangling lines so the file ends cleanly at the single `});` on the original line 682. After save, Metro recompiled (Web Bundled 2677ms, 1369 modules) and all screens load.
